{{Quote|I am Sai Sircu. Remember that name, for it is the herald of your impending deaths!|Sai Sircu, to two Jedi|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
'''Sai Sircu''' was a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Alliance===
{{Quote|We need not fear these Jedi, as always they are always too far behind.|Sai Sircu to [[Yansu Grjak]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance" />}}
[[File:Sairu.png|thumb|left|200px|Sai Sircu alongside Count Dooku and Asajj Ventress.]]
She and her fellow sister [[Yansu Grjak]] led an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] during the war between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At that time, they formed an alliance with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the Separatists in order to bring about the downfall of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She first attacked the ''Sedawan'' with her sister. It was later revealed on Dathomir that she had more sinister intentions in mind&mdash;the subjugation of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

===Devastation===
{{Quote|If a demonstration is what you want, then that's what you'll get.|Sai Sircu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance" />}}
Sai Sircu fought a pair of Jedi on her homeworld of Dathomir but was unable to prevent them from helping her valuable captive, Luminara Unduli, escape. After the Jedi freed Unduli, they pursued Sircu, who was confronted by a group of clone troops under the command of Cody. Using her dark powers, she managed to defeat them, but the capabilities of the Jedi were greater than hers, and she was forced to retreat. Meanwhile, the Republic established a garrison on Dathomir, capturing dozens of Nightsisters.

Sircu, however, eluded clone security and regrouped with her allies on the superweapon ''Devastation'', which included Count Dooku, his apprentice Asajj Ventress, and Darth Sidious himself, who made a rare appearance via holotransmitter. Dooku and Sircu assured Sidious that their weapon was far more powerful than any of them could have anticipated, and Ventress suggested a demonstration. Sidious agreed and Ventress set a course for Dathomir, but Sircu, angered over the sudden betrayel, blasted Dooku and Ventress with dark energy, forcing them out of the bridge. She now had command of the ship.

While Dooku made contact with his Master, Ventress confronted two of the six Jedi who had appeared to deactivate the ''Devastation''. However, Sircu accidentally gave her Jedi enemies an edge when she attacked Ventress, sealing their escape. Later, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] would confront her in the ship's main weapon chamber as she tried to insert the power from the gathered crystals into herself, which would make her extremely powerful were she to succeed. The two Jedi vanquished her and she perished as she lost control of her power and exploded in a burst of energy that destroyed the superweapon and the ship before it could target Coruscant or other important planets. All six Jedi, along with Dooku and Ventress were able to flee to safely on their ships in the ensuing destruction.
